caption: Listing sites end at price. DealGapIQ keeps going.
elevenLabsText: Listing sites end at price. <break time="0.35s" /> Investor calculators end at cash flow. <break time="0.55s" /> Neither tells you how to close a deal that doesn't pencil at asking. <break time="0.55s" /> That's where most tools stop. <break time="0.35s" /> DealGapIQ keeps going. <break time="0.65s" /> Paste any US address. <break time="0.3s" /> Search on the map. <break time="0.3s" /> Or use your phone to scan. <break time="0.5s" /> No signup. No credit card. <break time="0.5s" /> In about fifteen seconds you get a multi-source verdict, six strategies ranked side by side, and — when the numbers are tight — four ways to structure the offer, with a negotiation script for each.

caption: Live data. IQ Estimate. Never invent a number.
elevenLabsText: I'm going to run a real property. <break time="0.4s" /> Behind the scenes we're pulling live data — Zillow, RentCast, Redfin, Realtor.com — and blending what we can into an IQ Estimate. <break time="0.55s" /> If a source is missing, we show Unavailable. <break time="0.35s" /> We never invent a number.

caption: Deal Gap = the focus. We show you options.
elevenLabsText: This is your Verdict. <break time="0.5s" /> Three numbers say it all. <break time="0.35s" /> Target Buy — the price that hits your return thresholds. <break time="0.35s" /> Income Value — the max you can pay and still cash-flow positive. <break time="0.35s" /> Market Price — what the seller wants. <break time="0.55s" /> The Deal Gap between them is the focus. <break time="0.35s" /> Walk away. Negotiate. Or write the offer. <break time="0.4s" /> We show you options.

caption: Transparent sources. Six strategies.
elevenLabsText: Every metric shows its source. <break time="0.3s" /> Switch the estimate — watch the math change. <break time="0.5s" /> Nothing here is a black box. <break time="0.55s" /> Same property — six ways to profit. <break time="0.35s" /> Long-term rental. Short-term. B-R-R-R. Flip. House hack. Wholesale. <break time="0.5s" /> Ranked so you see which strategy fits this asset — without six separate spreadsheets.

caption: A negative gap is a structure problem.
elevenLabsText: Here's the part most tools never reach. <break time="0.55s" /> A negative gap isn't a dead deal. <break time="0.3s" /> It's a structure problem. <break time="0.55s" /> DealGapIQ builds four paths to close the gap: a price ask, a capital ask, financing — Subject-To, seller carry, creative structures — income re-verification, and a Blended Plan that combines smaller asks into one credible package. <break time="0.55s" /> A six-percent price cut can be a no. <break time="0.35s" /> Two percent plus seller carry plus verified rent can be the same math — and a yes.

caption: Pitch script — ready to dial.
elevenLabsText: And we don't stop at the spreadsheet. <break time="0.5s" /> For each path you get a pitch script: who to call, how to frame it, the opener, the ask, and what's in it for the seller. <break time="0.5s" /> Print it. Email it. Copy it to your phone before you dial. <break time="0.5s" /> From “does it pencil?” to “how do I actually get this under contract?”

caption: Live worksheet. Same math as the Verdict.
elevenLabsText: Deal Maker is the interactive worksheet. <break time="0.35s" /> Change purchase price. Down payment. Rent. Loan type. <break time="0.5s" /> Every metric recalculates live — and it stays consistent with the Verdict you just saw. <break time="0.5s" /> Same math. Same record. <break time="0.35s" /> When you're ready for a lender, export to Excel.

elevenLabsText: Don't have an address yet? <break time="0.35s" /> Hunt the whole market. <break time="0.5s" /> Map Search pre-grades parcels — with foreclosure, pre-foreclosure, and auction filters.
